about: Download Friend's Pass* to play Split Fiction with a friend for free on any platform! Try the early stages of the game in couch co-op or online cross-platform with another owner of the Friends Pass.
If a friend owns the full game, you can join them for the entire adventure for free.
1. Own Split Fiction 2. Friend Downloads Friend’s Pass on chosen platform 3. Send invite to a friend 4. Play the entire game together!

One minute you’re taming adorable dragons and the next you’re fighting as cyber ninjas, escaping terrifying trolls, or dodging hover cars thrown by a robotic parking attendant. Split Fiction is weird, wild and designed to be shared.
Grab a friend and get ready to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.
summary: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.
